notes: Seeded-defect inventory for judgment-layer regression evals (plan 2026-07-06 §6, WS-4). Fixtures carry inline <!-- DEFECT --> / <!-- CONTROL --> markers; a scored run must be produced WITHOUT showing the reviewer agent those markers (strip comments before dispatch, or instruct the pass to ignore HTML comments is NOT sufficient — strip them).

findings_file_schema.description: A scored run is a JSON file: {"fixture": <filename>, "pass": <skill-or-agent name>, "findings": [{"finding_code": str, "severity": str, "location_hint": str}]}. finding_code is the harness code family (e.g. 'C-6', 'C-8/M-1', 'C-6↔C-8/M-1', 'C-5/Check8-A').
findings_file_schema.matching_rule: code-family-first [AR-8]: a finding matches a seeded defect iff the defect's expected_code_family is a substring of the finding's finding_code (after stripping severity brackets), OR vice versa. location_hint is used only as a tiebreaker when one code family has multiple seeded instances in a fixture. Severity is reported but not required to match for recall. On the P1 control fixture, ANY finding whose code family is in p2_gated_families counts as a false positive.

defects.description: Glossary entry pre-states the payoff of the construct the argument exists to earn (keys-only carve-in violated).
Contested central construct stipulated by fiat, never derived.
Rival strawmanned and contradicted; no charitable reconstruction, no named buried assumption, no dissolution.
Load-bearing spatial/mechanical metaphor with no scope declaration.
Monotone-dense paragraph >150 words, no turn-point, no worked example at density spike.
Construct deployed before first-use definition (definition deferred to a later section without orientation).

controls.description: Open definition at P1 is correct non-convergence.
Undissolved rivals at P1 are appropriate deferral.
